_note: v2 hook overrides for la tente de l'Hercule (B53_hercule). Source hooks are kept wherever the painting shows them; these replace hooks that differ from what is painted (nothing may be written in the paintings), and mark the mature words that appear only as a blank museum plaque.

fr_viril_adj.hook: Like English 'virile', said vee-REEL: wall text: VIRIL, VIRILE or MANLY, describing traditionally masculine strength or vigour.
fr_viril_adj.why: Mature word: shown only as museum-wall text on a blank board, never pictured.

fr_sensuel_adj.hook: Like English 'sensual', said sahn-SWEHL: wall text: SENSUEL, SENSUAL, relating to the pleasures of the senses, such as a fine fabric or a rich perfume.
fr_sensuel_adj.why: Mature word: shown only as museum-wall text on a blank board, never pictured.

fr_sordide_adj.hook: Like English 'sordid', said sor-DEED: wall text: SORDIDE, SORDID or SQUALID, dirty and miserable, or morally shabby.
fr_sordide_adj.why: Mature word: shown only as museum-wall text on a blank board, never pictured.

fr_inhumain_adj.hook: Like English 'inhuman', said ee-new-MAN: wall text: INHUMAIN, INHUMANE, cruel and without any compassion, as in inhumane treatment.
fr_inhumain_adj.why: Mature word: shown only as museum-wall text on a blank board, never pictured.

fr_pervers_adj.hook: Like English 'perverse', said pehr-VEHR: wall text: PERVERS, PERVERSE or WICKED, taking pleasure in doing harm.
fr_pervers_adj.why: Mature word: shown only as museum-wall text on a blank board, never pictured.

fr_epileptique_adj.hook: Like English 'epileptic', said ay-pih-lehp-TEEK: wall text: ÉPILEPTIQUE, EPILEPTIC, relating to epilepsy, a neurological condition causing seizures.
fr_epileptique_adj.why: Mature word: shown only as museum-wall text on a blank board, never pictured.

fr_funebre_adj.hook: Like English 'funeral', said few-NEHBR: wall text: FUNÈBRE, FUNERAL or MOURNFUL, as in a slow funeral march played on a brass band.
fr_funebre_adj.why: Sombre word kept off the picture: shown only as wall text on a blank board with a black bow.

fr_aerien_adj.hook: Like English 'aerial', said ah-ay-RYAN: RYAN the trapeze artist swings on the ropes high above the strongman tent, so AERIAL that his top hat flies off.
fr_aerien_adj.why: Painted: Ryan swinging on the trapeze ropes with his hat flying off, not a somersault and catch.

fr_durable_adj.hook: Like English 'durable', said dew-RAHBL: the DURABLE old tent roof, patched with dozens of bright squares, has survived storms, elephants and acrobats.
fr_durable_adj.why: The patches are painted on the tent roof; there are dozens rather than exactly one hundred.

fr_portable_adj.hook: Like English 'portable', said por-TAHBL: a strongwoman carries a whole PORT TABLE top under one arm, completely PORTABLE.
fr_portable_adj.why: The painting shows a strongwoman carrying a table top.

fr_lache_adj.hook: A COWARDLY lion hides behind his paw by a barrel, his eyelashes ("LASH") fluttering shut.
fr_lache_adj.why: No loose rope is painted; the lion hiding behind his paw with fluttering lashes carries the sound.

fr_passionnant_adj.hook: Like English 'passionate', said pah-syoh-NAHN: NAN is so FASCINATED by the little mouse's workout that she peers over her glasses and forgets her knitting.
fr_passionnant_adj.why: Painted: Nan watching the mouse lift dumbbells; there is no arm-wrestle in this room.

fr_las_adj.hook: A WEARY traveller in a helmet slumps in his seat and lets out a huge yawning "LAAA".
fr_las_adj.why: Painted: a helmeted traveller yawning in a chair rather than on a bench singing.

fr_emouvant_adj.hook: A MOVING film: two children sniffle at a movie ("ay-moo-VON") about a lost puppy on a little screen.
fr_emouvant_adj.why: Painted as two children at a small screen, not a whole cinema.

fr_sacre_adj.hook: Reverent: close to "sacred", said sah-KRAY: an old SACRED bell hangs quietly in a little wooden bell tower.
fr_sacre_adj.why: Painted as a small wooden bell tower rather than a chapel.

fr_total_adj.hook: Like English 'total', said toh-TAHL: a TALL strongman hoists the TOTAL set of dumbbells all at once.
fr_total_adj.why: The toe balance could not be painted clearly; the tall strongman lifts the whole set instead.

fr_delicat_adj.hook: Like English 'delicate', said day-lee-KAH: a DELI CAT in an apron tiptoes beside a row of eggs, very DELICATE with each paw.
fr_delicat_adj.why: Painted: the deli cat in an apron beside the eggs, not on top of them.

fr_paisible_adj.hook: Like English 'peaceable', said pay-ZEEBL: a PEACEFUL lion naps with a butterfly resting on his nose.
fr_paisible_adj.why: No bench is painted under the lion.

fr_genant_adj.hook: An EMBARRASSING moment: a jay ("zheh") bird lands on a man's head in the middle of his speech.
fr_genant_adj.why: The man is not shown as a mayor.

fr_gracieux_adj.hook: Like English 'gracious', said grah-SYEUH: a GRACEFUL swan glides along and bows to a duckling as if to SEE her safely home.
fr_gracieux_adj.why: No grassy pond edge is painted.

fr_vulnerable_adj.hook: Like English 'vulnerable', said vewl-nay-RAHBL: a strongman gently shields a VULNERABLE baby turtle with his big hands.
fr_vulnerable_adj.why: Painted as one strongman protecting the turtle; no sea or line of strongmen.

fr_majestueux_adj.hook: Like English 'majestic', said mah-zhehs-TWEUH: a MAJESTIC stag stands proud, a robin perched on one antler like a jewel.
fr_majestueux_adj.why: The sunrise hilltop is not painted in the small cubby.

fr_abondant_adj.hook: Like English 'abundant', said ah-bohn-DAHN: DAN the strongman staggers under an ABUNDANT armful of apples.
fr_abondant_adj.why: Painted as Dan carrying a great armful of apples; no rope bond.

fr_numerique_adj.hook: Like English 'numeric', said new-may-REEK: a DIGITAL scoreboard shows the strongman's NEW record as bright red bars climbing higher and higher.
fr_numerique_adj.why: Numbers are text and nothing may be written, so the scoreboard shows red bars.

fr_contagieux_adj.hook: Like English 'contagious', said kohn-tah-ZHYEUH: a strongman's giggle is so CONTAGIOUS that even the lion beside him starts laughing.
fr_contagieux_adj.why: Painted: the strongman and the lion laughing together.

fr_violent_adj.hook: Like English 'violent', said vyoh-LAHN: a VIOLIN is played so VIOLENTLY that its strings snap and curl.
fr_violent_adj.why: Painted: the violin with snapped, curling strings.

fr_cruel_adj.hook: Like English 'cruel', said krew-EHL: a grumpy CRUEL wind cloud blows the CREW's tent pegs out one by one.
fr_cruel_adj.why: The wind is painted as a grumpy blowing cloud.

fr_furieux_adj.hook: Like English 'furious', said few-RYEUH: a FURIOUS kettle whistles so loudly that its lid flies off and the strongman jumps.
fr_furieux_adj.why: Painted with the startled strongman beside the kettle.

fr_brutal_adj.hook: Like English 'brutal', said brew-TAHL: a TALL BRUTE of a strongman grips an iron bar with BRUTAL force, then gently pats a kitten.
fr_brutal_adj.why: The bar is gripped, not visibly bent.

fr_dramatique_adj.hook: Like English 'dramatic', said drah-mah-TEEK: a strongman faints DRAMATICALLY onto a little TEAK bench, still holding a feather.
fr_dramatique_adj.why: Painted: fainting onto a small bench with the feather in hand.

fr_excessif_adj.hook: Like English 'excessive', said ehk-say-SEEF: a strongman uses EXCESSIVE force on a jam jar and it bursts.
fr_excessif_adj.why: Painted as the jar bursting rather than the lid leaving the tent.

fr_feroce_adj.hook: Like English 'ferocious', said fay-ROS: ROSS the kitten stands on a stool and gives his most FEROCIOUS roar, a tiny squeak.
fr_feroce_adj.why: Painted with the kitten on a stool.

fr_menacant_adj.hook: Like English 'menacing', said muh-nah-SAHN: a MENACING storm cloud glowers over a little striped tent.
fr_menacant_adj.why: The single raindrop is too small to read in the cubby.

fr_impuissant_adj.hook: A POWERLESS ("an-pwee-SAHN") imp, wee as a mouse, sits on a heap of straw holding a little toy sword.
fr_impuissant_adj.why: Painted: a tiny red imp with a toy sword on straw; no broken sword or sun.

fr_force_adj.hook: Like English 'forced', said for-SAY: a strongman flashes a FORCED grin as a hippo SAYS "my turn" and sits on top of him.
fr_force_adj.why: Painted: the hippo sitting on the strongman, who grins stiffly.

fr_exigeant_adj.hook: A DEMANDING secret agent inspects an egg ("eg-zee-ZHON") with a magnifying glass.
fr_exigeant_adj.why: Painted as one egg under the magnifier.

fr_imposant_adj.hook: Like English 'imposing', said an-poh-ZAHN: an IMPOSING strongman strikes a POSE so big that he shoves the tent pole aside.
fr_imposant_adj.why: Painted: the pose pushing the pole aside rather than bending it.

fr_fatal_adj.hook: Like English 'fatal', said fah-TAHL: a FAT, TALL safety net is strung below the acrobat, because a fall from up there could be FATAL.
fr_fatal_adj.why: No warning sign is painted (nothing may be written).

fr_extraordinaire_adj.hook: Like English 'extraordinaire', said ehk-strah-or-dee-NEHR: a strongman lifts a whole wardrobe as if it were nothing, EXTRAORDINARY.
fr_extraordinaire_adj.why: Painted: a strongman lifting a wardrobe; the piano belongs to the extrême hook.

fr_supreme_adj.hook: Like English 'supreme', said sew-PREHM: a little mouse in a crown stands proud, the SUPREME champion of the tent.
fr_supreme_adj.why: Painted: a crowned mouse; the cheese wheel belongs to the absolu hook.

fr_extreme_adj.hook: Like English 'extreme', said ehk-STREHM: a strongman goes to the EXTREME, holding a piano overhead with a cat sitting on top.
fr_extreme_adj.why: Painted: the cat sits on the piano rather than playing it.

fr_absolu_adj.hook: Like English 'absolute', said ahp-soh-LEW: the ringmaster cheers a tiny mouse, the ABSOLUTE champion, who has just lifted a whole wheel of cheese.
fr_absolu_adj.why: Painted: the ringmaster cheering beside the mouse.

fr_supplementaire_adj.hook: Like English 'supplementary', said sew-play-mahn-TEHR: a strongman keeps adding EXTRA weights until his bar is loaded right up, lifted high in the AIR.
fr_supplementaire_adj.why: The bar is painted fully loaded but not bent.

fr_ultime_adj.hook: Like English 'ultimate', said ewl-TEEM: the ULTIMATE challenge: a whole strongman TEAM in a tug-of-war against one tiny mouse.
fr_ultime_adj.why: Painted as a tug-of-war; no bus.

fr_monstrueux_adj.hook: Like English 'monstrous', said mohns-trew-EUH: a MONSTROUS pumpkin is wheeled in on a cart, and it's TRUE: it weighs more than any strongman.

fr_sublime_adj.hook: Like English 'sublime', said sew-BLEEM: a SUBLIME sunset turns the sea to gold, and a seagull hovers to stare.

fr_insignifiant_adj.hook: Like English 'insignificant', said an-see-nyee-FYAHN: ANN the strongwoman proudly lifts an INSIGNIFICANT pea right next to a huge boulder.
fr_insignifiant_adj.why: Painted: Ann with a pea beside a boulder; the fee cannot be shown.

fr_secondaire_adj.hook: Like English 'secondary', said suh-gohn-DEHR: the strongman's SECONDARY act: balancing a teacup on his hand.
fr_secondaire_adj.why: Painted on his hand, not his nose.

fr_heroique_adj.hook: Like English 'heroic', said ay-roh-EEK: a HEROIC mouse lifts a dumbbell off a trapped beetle.

fr_radical_adj.hook: Like English 'radical', said rah-dee-KAHL: CAL the strongman tries a RADICAL new trick: lifting a little tent while the spectators stay inside.
fr_radical_adj.why: Painted as a small tent with spectators.

fr_dominant_adj.hook: Like English 'dominant', said doh-mee-NAHN: the DOMINANT gorilla stacks DOMINOES and dares anyone to topple them.
fr_dominant_adj.why: Painted without the strongman tent detail.

fr_vigilant_adj.hook: Like English 'vigilant', said vee-zhee-LAHN: a VIGILANT meerkat stands up behind the strongman's head, scanning the crowd.
fr_vigilant_adj.why: Painted behind his head rather than on it.

fr_incessant_adj.hook: Like English 'incessant', said an-say-SAHN: a rabbit perched on a drum thumps his foot with INCESSANT drumming that keeps the whole tent awake.
fr_incessant_adj.why: Painted: the rabbit on a drum.

fr_continuel_adj.hook: Like English 'continual', said kohn-tee-NWEHL: a strongman's CONTINUAL puffing has blown a balloon up as big as a globe.
fr_continuel_adj.why: Painted as a globe-sized balloon in his hand.

fr_resistant_adj.hook: Like English 'resistant', said ray-zees-TAHN: a RESISTANT strongman stands firm in front of a hurricane fan without moving an inch.
fr_resistant_adj.why: Painted: the strongman braced before the fan.

fr_intensif_adj.hook: Like English 'intensive', said an-tahn-SEEF: a hamster's INTENSIVE training: hours and hours on the wheel.

fr_alternatif_adj.hook: Like English 'alternative', said ahl-tehr-nah-TEEF: an ALTERNATING lamp flashes red, green, red, green; here it is caught half and half.
fr_alternatif_adj.why: Painted as one lamp, half red and half green.

fr_maximal_adj.hook: Like English 'maximal', said mahk-see-MAHL: MAX the strongman goes red in the face lifting the bar with MAXIMAL effort.

fr_polaire_adj.hook: Like English 'polar', said poh-LEHR: a POLAR bear peeks out of her icy LAIR.
fr_polaire_adj.why: Painted as the bear in her ice cave.

fr_ferre_adj.hook: A FAIRY (feh-RAY) who knows all about horses kneels with an IRON horseshoe: she is ferrée en la matière, WELL UP in it. Un cheval ferré = a horse with IRON shoes.
fr_ferre_adj.why: Painted: the fairy holding the horseshoe; no pony beside her.

fr_agile_adj.hook: Like English 'agile', said ah-ZHEEL: an AGILE squirrel leaps clean over a barbell.

fr_debutant_adj.hook: Like English 'debutant', said day-bew-TAHN: a BEGINNER mouse lifts his first 'weights', two peas on sticks.
fr_debutant_adj.why: Painted as two peas on sticks.

fr_robuste_adj.hook: Like English 'robust', said roh-BEWST: a ROBUST robot bust lifts a wooden pole with one metal arm.
fr_robuste_adj.why: Painted as a short pole, not the tent pole.

fr_frise_adj.hook: Like English 'frizzy', said free-ZAY: the strongman's CURLY hair is so frizzy that two kittens nest in it.
fr_frise_adj.why: Painted: kittens, not birds, in the hair nest.

fr_instable_adj.hook: Like English 'unstable', said ans-TAHBL: a strongman balances an UNSTABLE wobbly chair on his head, a kitten on top.
fr_instable_adj.why: Painted as one chair on his head.

fr_viable_adj.hook: Like English 'viable', said VYAHBL: a VIABLE plan: a beaver proudly shows his dam drawn neatly on a sheet of paper.
fr_viable_adj.why: Painted on a sheet, not a napkin.

fr_rigide_adj.hook: Like English 'rigid', said ree-ZHEED: a strongman goes RIGID as a plank, laid across two chairs while a pony stands on him.
fr_rigide_adj.why: Painted with a pony, not a goat.

fr_toxique_adj.hook: Like English 'toxic', said tok-SEEK: a TOXIC green potion makes the pot plant beside it droop and wilt.
fr_toxique_adj.why: The plant droops in its pot rather than falling.

fr_captif_adj.hook: Like English 'captive', said kahp-TEEF: the canary has flown free, and now a CAPTIVE clown is stuck in the cage instead.
fr_captif_adj.why: Painted: the clown inside the cage, the canary flying outside.

fr_provocant_adj.hook: Like English 'provocative', said proh-voh-KAHN: a PROVOCATIVE monkey waves a banana to tease everyone.
fr_provocant_adj.why: No strongman is painted beside the monkey.

fr_provocateur_adj.hook: Like English 'provocateur', said proh-voh-kah-TUHR: a PROVOCATIVE monkey sticks out his tongue at the crowd.
fr_provocateur_adj.why: No strongman is painted beside the monkey.

fr_revoltant_adj.hook: Like English 'revolting', said ray-vol-TAHN: a REVOLTING smell of old socks makes a rat hold his nose.
fr_revoltant_adj.why: Painted: smelly socks and a rat holding his nose.

fr_militant_adj.hook: Like English 'militant', said mee-lee-TAHN, but softer in French: un militant is usually an ACTIVIST handing out leaflets for his cause, holding up a sign.
fr_militant_adj.why: Painted backstage, with a blank sign (nothing may be written).

fr_immodere_adj.hook: Like English 'immoderate', said ee-moh-day-RAY: an IMMODERATE appetite: a goat munches its way through a whole curtain.

fr_ephemere_adj.hook: Like English 'ephemeral', said ay-fay-MEHR: an EPHEMERAL soap bubble shaped like a little MARE floats by, about to pop.

fr_apocalyptique_adj.hook: Like English 'apocalyptic', said ah-poh-kah-leep-TEEK: an APOCALYPTIC thunderstorm, black and crackling with lightning, over a little tent.
fr_apocalyptique_adj.why: Painted over a small model tent.

fr_croissant_adj.hook: Not "croissant" pastry here: croissant (krwah-SAHN) means INCREASING; a crescent moon grows bigger and bigger until it is full.
fr_croissant_adj.why: Painted as a row of moons growing.

fr_devastateur_adj.hook: Like English 'devastating', said day-vahs-tah-TUHR: a DEVASTATING sneeze blows a little tent clean away.
fr_devastateur_adj.why: Painted: a man sneezing away a small tent.

fr_troublant_adj.hook: Like English 'troubling', said troo-BLAHN: a TROUBLING sight: the strongman's barbell floats up, tied to a bunch of balloons.
fr_troublant_adj.why: Painted with balloons tied to a real barbell.

fr_clement_adj.hook: Like English 'clement', said klay-MAHN: a CLEMENT judge lets the clay-covered puppy off with just a bath.
fr_clement_adj.why: Painted: the judge bathing the puppy.

fr_effroyable_adj.hook: A TERRIFYING bull glowers beside a giant FROYO cup ("ayf-rwah-YAHBL": froyo + bull), and a tiny bug scurries away.
fr_effroyable_adj.why: Painted as a bull beside a frozen-yogurt cup, not a bull made of froyo in a parlour.

fr_excitant_adj.hook: Like English 'exciting', said ehk-see-TAHN: an EXCITING moment: the strongman lifts the elephant and the mice leap up cheering.
fr_excitant_adj.why: Painted with mice as the crowd.

fr_dechirant_adj.hook: HEARTBREAKING farewell: on the day she ran ("day-shee-RAHN") for the train, a little girl waved goodbye from the carriage while the puppies cried.
fr_dechirant_adj.why: Painted: the girl waving from a train carriage with puppies in tears.

fr_epuisant_adj.hook: A tired peasant ("ay-pwee-ZAHN") has dragged a plough all day: EXHAUSTING work, and he flops onto a haystack.
fr_epuisant_adj.why: Painted flopped on the haystack beside the plough.

fr_bouleversant_adj.hook: A gentle bull sings a verse ("bool-vehr-SAHN") so HEARTRENDING that two hens weep beside him.
